verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a hosted AI generation platform and API like Luma, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection, or storage location controls. The Enterprise tier and dedicated-capacity offering cover throughput and latency, not where data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
